original_alert.finding: Proof 1.1 says: 'The restrictions of any two maps f,g:M(μ)→M(λ) are proportional, say f|_S=cg|_S.' This oriented equality need not exist when g=0 and f≠0; injectivity makes f|_S≠0. The dimension claim remains sound: handle the zero Hom space separately and fix a nonzero g before comparing arbitrary f. This is an immediate proof repair, not a false theorem.
